prompt: You want to play chess and your friend wants to play cards, and there is only time for one game today. Which plan is the fairest compromise?

options.text: Play your game today and your friend's game tomorrow
Play your game today and your game again tomorrow
Refuse to play anything at all
Let a coin flip decide every single time, forever

explanation: Taking turns across two days gives both friends their choice in full — a compromise where nobody has to lose today and be forgotten tomorrow.
